messages:
maya: Heads-up — we found a high CVE in libssl inside the runtime base image used by Dedicated pools. Need a coordinated minimal base-image rebuild + signing + RBAC prechecks. Patch is small but rollout affects live inference hosts. Goals: (1) rebuild a minimal image, (2) sign with KMS-backed cosign, (3) ensure audit logs capture builder SA actions, (4) canary to a tight host group. Target: tomorrow 09:30 PT. :rotating_light:

liam: Can we get a list of services that mount the runtime rootfs? want to know restart blast radius. quick inventory pls. :eyes:

anika: I can wire CI to emit SBOM + deterministic build metadata. cosign flow needs the KMS plugin; CI runner will need a scoped signer SA. Will add a job that does a reproducible build and signs the artifact.

ron: RBAC note — please avoid granting wide iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob. Prefer a short-lived signer SA with only kms.sign and access to push to staging registry. Also add a k8s RoleBinding scoped to the build-runner ns.

security-bot: Scan alert: redwood/runtime:2026-03-18 -> CVE-2026-1234 (libssl) severity=HIGH. Full report: https://scans.internal/reports/3284 :warning:

maya: Proposed run sequence:
- A: create ephemeral signer SA + narrow k8s RoleBinding for build-runner
- B: CI produces SBOM + repro metadata
- C: sign with cosign via KMS plugin (no private key stored in CI)
- D: push signed image to staging repo (tag: rebase-2026-03-18)
- E: canary deploy to a small subset of Dedicated pool (tagged canary-rebase)
- F: monitor audit logs & metrics; rollback on regressions
Who volunteers for A / C / E?

anika: I own CI changes + cosign integration. I'll add a job like:
```
./ci/build.sh --target minimal --sbom out/sbom.json
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/cosign --output-bundle out/cosign.bundle
```
CI runner will need permission to call KMS sign via the signer SA. I'll add unit tests that validate bundle exists.

liam: I'll own the canary deploy. Will coordinate with eng-runtime to reserve 3 machines from the Dedicated pool and tag them `canary-rebase`. Need image push window and a zero-downtime restart checklist.

ron: I'll file the IAM request for an ephemeral signer SA with a 4h TTL and least-privilege policy. I'll also add an audit log filter to stream `projects/*/serviceAccounts/*:signBlob` and `kms.cryptoKeyVersions.*` to sec-logging.

security-bot: Note: enable cosign `--bundle` so we capture provenance and SBOM linkage. Without bundle you lose full attestation metadata.

maya: Quick checklist for tomorrow morning: RBAC ticket + IAM grant (ron), CI change + test build and bundle (anika), reserve canary capacity + deploy plan (liam), prepare rollback playbook + dashboard (maya). I'll draft a short runbook and link it here.

deploy-bot: Job queued: `run-rebase-staging-3284512345` submitted by anika — ETA ~3h.

anika: Uploaded initial runbook draft: https://docs.internal/runbooks/rebase-3284512345. It includes the deploy commands, rollback steps, and required PRs.

maya: tagging @oncall for awareness. We'll do a 09:15 PT sync to sanity-check the canary and logs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
